title: Provider-neutral private core
description: Invariant, secret-free governance skeleton with domain and carrier paths generated from an approved bootstrap profile.

invariants.purpose: Operator landing page, instance purpose, boundaries, and administration map.
System map, source-of-truth decisions, lifecycle, and ADR references.
Data membrane, consent, retention, routing, publication, and deletion rules.
System, carrier, domain-topology, and instance manifests.
Bridge, artifact, alias, and stable-identity registries.
Provider bindings nested beneath abstract carrier roles.
History-derived durable domains. Empty until generated from the approved profile.
Repeatable transformations, reviews, and operational routines.
Private prompt overlays, macros, skills, and reusable language artifacts.
Versioned definitions and mappings for the semantic control plane, not copied page bodies.
Architecture, reconciliation, migration, and maintenance history.
Superseded or retired durable representations with provenance.

generated_paths.purpose: One directory per approved durable domain, containing purpose, routes, workflows, and references rather than raw source exports.
Provider-specific bindings isolated beneath stable semantic roles.

rules: No provider name becomes a top-level domain solely because it is a provider.
No raw chat or notebook archive is committed by default.
Living semantic content is referenced at its canonical carrier rather than duplicated.
Every generated domain documents artifact routes and canonical roles.
The core remains secret-free even when the repository is private.
